q: Spell Checker 应该返回什么？
q_en: What should the spell checker return?
options: 字典里所有词，不分跟 query 差多远，全部按频率从高到低整体排序返回
query 本身所有可能的拼写变体组合，无论是不是字典里的真词
maxDistance 内的字典真词，最多 maxSuggestions 个
只返回与 query 编辑距离恰好为 0 的完全匹配词条，其余一律不算
options_en: All dictionary words, regardless of how far they are from the query, sorted from most to least frequent.
Every possible spelling-variant combination of the query, whether or not it is a real dictionary word.
Real dictionary words within maxDistance edits, capped at maxSuggestions results.
Only words whose edit distance from the query is exactly zero, nothing else counts.
why: 候选必须来自字典、编辑距离不超过 maxDistance，且数量受 maxSuggestions 限制。

optionExplanations: 这其实是把结果当成整份词表按频率排的排行榜，没用到 maxDistance 过滤，会带出跟拼写错误无关的高频词。
把结果当成 query 的编辑变体集合，没有约束候选必须是字典真词，容易混进不存在的乱码。
对，它同时满足三个约束：候选是字典里的真实词条、编辑距离落在 maxDistance 以内、返回数量落在上限以内。
把 maxDistance 收窄成 0，只留完全匹配，会漏掉几乎所有真正需要的拼写建议。

This treats every spelling variant of the query as a candidate without requiring it be an actual dictionary entry, so garbage strings can slip through.
Right — it satisfies three constraints at once: the candidate is an actual dictionary entry, its edit distance stays inside maxDistance, and the returned count stays inside maxSuggestions.
This shrinks maxDistance down to zero and keeps only exact matches, so it misses nearly every real suggestion the user needed.

q: Levenshtein edit distance 允许哪些单字符操作？
q_en: Which single-character operations does Levenshtein edit distance allow here?
options: 交换相邻字符、排序、反转
只允许删除
只允许替换
插入、删除、替换
options_en: Swap adjacent characters, sort, or reverse the string.
Only deletion.
Only substitution.
Insertion, deletion, and substitution.
why: Levenshtein 距离计算把一个字符串变成另一个所需的最少插入、删除、替换次数。
why_en: Levenshtein distance counts the minimum insertions, deletions, and substitutions needed to transform one string into another.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把一个字符串变成另一个所需的最少插入、删除、替换次数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Levenshtein distance is the minimum number of insertions, deletions, and substitutions needed to turn one string into another.

optionExplanations: 这套换位/排序/反转操作属于另一种距离定义，Levenshtein 本身不包含换位。

只算替换会漏掉漏打字母这类常见 typo，同样覆盖不全。
对，插入、删除、替换正好覆盖多打、少打、打错三类最常见的 typo。
optionExplanations_en: Swap/sort/reverse belongs to a different distance metric — Levenshtein itself never includes transposition.
Counting only deletion misses common typos like an extra typed letter.
Counting only substitution misses common typos like a dropped letter.
Right — insert, delete, and substitute together cover the three most common typo shapes: extra, missing, and wrong character.

q: 补全排序规则：
q_en: Complete the ranking rule:
text: 建议词先按 {{edit distance 升序}} 排序；距离相同时按 {{frequency 降序}}；再用 {{word 字典序}} 做稳定 tie-break。
why: 更少编辑更可能是目标词，同距离下高频词更可能是用户想输入的词，最后用字典序保证输出不随字典遍历顺序漂移。
why_en: Suggestions rank by smaller edit distance first, then higher frequency, then lexicographic order as a stable final tie-break.

termDefinitions.meaning: 多个候选得分完全相同时，用来决定最终顺序的额外规则。

scenario: 需要计算 query 和 candidate 的 Levenshtein 距离，允许插入、删除、替换。

q: 最标准的核心算法是什么？
q_en: What is the standard core algorithm?
options: BFS 网格寻路
二维 DP 表
拓扑排序
二叉搜索
options_en: BFS grid pathfinding.
A two-dimensional DP table.
Topological sort.
Binary search.
why: 编辑距离是 DP 教科书问题：每个单元复用更短前缀的解，把指数级搜索变成表格填充。
why_en: Edit distance is the canonical DP problem because every cell reuses the answers to shorter prefixes instead of re-searching from scratch.
whenOtherWins: 如果只需判断前缀或精确匹配，trie 或 hash set 更直接；编辑距离才需要 DP。
tradeoff: DP 表填充的确定性 vs 图搜索/排序类算法各自的适配场景

termDefinitions.meaning: 把大问题拆成可复用的小问题，填表得到答案的算法技巧。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Dynamic programming solves a problem by reusing answers to overlapping smaller subproblems, typically filled into a table.

diagram:
flowchart TD
  Empty[Empty prefix] --> Row[Base row]
  Empty --> Col[Base col]
  Row --> Cell[dp i j]
  Col --> Cell

optionExplanations: BFS 适合有明确图结构的最短路径问题，但编辑距离没有天然的节点-边图，硬套会很别扭。
对，编辑距离每个单元格只依赖更短前缀已经算出的结果，二维 DP 表正好复用这些子问题。
拓扑排序适合任务之间有依赖顺序时排序，候选词之间没有这种依赖关系。
二叉搜索要求数据已经有序，编辑距离不是在有序集合里查找。
optionExplanations_en: BFS fits shortest-path problems with a clear node-edge graph, but edit distance has no natural graph structure to search over.
Right — each cell only needs results already worked out for smaller prefixes, and a 2D table is exactly the structure built to reuse those overlapping subproblems.
Topological sort fits tasks with a dependency order, but candidate words have no such ordering between them.
Binary search needs already-sorted data, and this problem isn't a lookup over a sorted collection at all.

q: 补全 DP 单元定义：
q_en: Complete the DP cell definition:
text: `dp[i][j]` 表示把 source 的前 {{i}} 个字符变成 target 的前 {{j}} 个字符所需的最少编辑次数。
why: 把子问题定义成两个前缀之间的距离后，插入、删除、替换都能直接引用已经算好的相邻单元格。
why_en: Once the subproblem is the distance between two prefixes, insertions, deletions, and substitutions can all reuse already-computed neighboring cells.

termDefinitions.meaning: DP 表中的一个单元，存的是两个前缀之间的最少编辑次数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: dp[i][j] is a table cell holding the minimum edit distance between two string prefixes.

scenario: 为 spell checker 手写 Levenshtein DP 表，query 长 Q、候选词长 L，先要填好与空串比较的边界格。
scenario_en: You're hand-writing the Levenshtein DP table for a spell checker, so the boundary cells comparing against the empty string must be filled first.
q: Levenshtein DP 的第一行和第一列如何初始化？（多选）
q_en: How should the first row and first column of Levenshtein DP be initialized? (multi-select)
options: 第一行和第一列都必须是 0
`dp[i][0] = i`，删除 i 个字符变成空串
`dp[0][j] = j`，插入 j 个字符从空串变成 target 前缀
options_en: The first row and column must all be zero.
dp[i][0] = i, deleting i characters down to the empty string.
dp[0][j] = j, inserting j characters up from the empty string.
why: 空串与非空前缀之间只能靠全插入或全删除，长度本身就是编辑代价。
why_en: Base cases between the empty string and a prefix are just the number of insertions or deletions needed, i.e. the prefix length.

termDefinitions.meaning: DP 表中的一个单元，存的是两个前缀之间的最少编辑次数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: dp[i][j] is a table cell holding the minimum edit distance between two string prefixes.

optionExplanations: 误把两条边界都设成 0；除了 dp[0][0]，其余边界值其实是位置本身，不是常数 0。
对，空串删到长度 i 的前缀要删 i 次，所以 dp[i][0] = i。
同理，空串插到长度 j 的前缀要插 j 次，dp[0][j] = j。
两个空串之间不用编辑，dp[0][0] = 0 是唯一真正的 0 值起点。
optionExplanations_en: This wrongly sets both boundaries to zero; every boundary cell except dp[0][0] actually equals its own position, not a constant zero.
Right — shrinking a length-i prefix down to nothing takes i deletions, so dp[i][0] = i.
By the same logic, inserting up from empty to a length-j prefix takes j insertions, so dp[0][j] = j.
Two empty strings need zero edits, making dp[0][0] = 0 the one genuine zero-value starting point.

scenario: spell checker 的 Levenshtein DP 逐格填表，现在要处理 query 第 i 位与候选词第 j 位这一步。
scenario_en: The spell checker's Levenshtein DP is filling cell by cell, and you're now handling character i of the query against character j of the candidate.
q: DP 转移里，替换/匹配来自哪个单元？
q_en: In the DP transition, which cell supplies replacement or match?
options: `dp[i][j-1]` 固定加 2
`dp[i-1][j]` 固定加 0
`dp[i-1][j-1]` 加上字符不同的代价
options_en: dp[i][j-1] plus a fixed 2.
dp[i-1][j] plus a fixed 0.
dp[i-1][j-1] plus the mismatch cost.
why: 对角线单元同时消耗两个字符串的最后一位，相同则加 0，不同则加 1 次替换。
why_en: The diagonal cell consumes the last character of both strings, adding zero on a match or one for a substitution.

termDefinitions.meaning: DP 表中的一个单元，存的是两个前缀之间的最少编辑次数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: dp[i][j] is a table cell holding the minimum edit distance between two string prefixes.

optionExplanations: 这其实是插入转移用的单元格，而且插入代价应该是 1，不是 2。
这其实是删除转移用的单元格，删除代价应该是 1，不是 0。
对，这个位置要同时看两个字符串各自的最后一个字符：一样就不加代价，不一样就加一次替换代价。
dp[i+1][j+1] 还没被算出来，DP 不能引用未来的单元格。
optionExplanations_en: This is actually the cell used for insertion, and insertion costs 1, not a flat 2.
This is actually the cell used for deletion, and deletion costs 1, not a flat 0.
Right — this cell has to look at the final character from each string at once: matching costs nothing, and a mismatch costs exactly one swap.
dp[i+1][j+1] has not been computed yet — DP can only reuse cells that are already filled.

scenario: spell checker 用 Levenshtein DP 算 query 与候选词的距离，只允许插入、删除、替换三种单字符操作。
scenario_en: The spell checker computes query-to-candidate distance with Levenshtein DP, allowing only insertion, deletion, and substitution.
q: 计算 `dp[i][j]` 时通常取哪些候选的最小值？（多选）
q_en: When computing `dp[i][j]`, which candidate values do we usually take the minimum over? (multi-select)
options: 跳过两个字符：`dp[i-2][j-2]` 不加成本
替换或匹配：`dp[i-1][j-1] + cost`
options_en: Insertion: dp[i][j-1] + 1.
Skip two characters for free: dp[i-2][j-2].
Deletion: dp[i-1][j] + 1.
Substitution or match: dp[i-1][j-1] + cost.
why: 三种允许的单字符操作正好对应左、上、左上三个已经算好的子问题。
why_en: The three allowed single-character edits map directly onto the left, top, and diagonal neighboring cells.

termDefinitions.meaning: DP 表中的一个单元，存的是两个前缀之间的最少编辑次数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: dp[i][j] is a table cell holding the minimum edit distance between two string prefixes.

diagram:
flowchart TD
  Up[delete from source] --> Min[Take minimum]
  Left[insert into source] --> Min
  Diag[match or replace] --> Min
  Min --> Cell[dp i j]
optionExplanations: 对，target 这一位比 source 多出一个字符，补上它正是一次插入。
Levenshtein 只定义单字符操作，没有一次跳两格还不计代价这种走法。
对，source 这一位比 target 多出一个字符，去掉它正是一次删除。
对，这一位比较两字符串的最后一位，相同就是匹配，不同就是替换。
optionExplanations_en: Right — target has one extra character at this position, and closing that gap is exactly one insertion.
Levenshtein only defines edits on one character at a time — there's no free two-letter jump like this.
Right — source has one extra character at this position, and removing it is exactly one deletion.
Right — this compares the last character of both strings: a match if they're equal, a substitution if not.

scenario: 你正在填 Levenshtein DP 表，`source[i-1]` 和 `target[j-1]` 是当前比较的字符。
scenario_en: You are filling the Levenshtein DP table, and `source[i-1]` and `target[j-1]` are the current characters.
q: 哪段代码最符合文章中的转移？
q_en: Which code best matches the transition from the article?
options: dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1] + abs(i - j)
dp[i][j] = i + j if i != j else 0
dp[i][j] = min(dp[i][j-1]+1, dp[i-1][j]+1, dp[i-1][j-1]+cost)
options_en: Take the max of insert, delete, and the raw diagonal cell, with no mismatch cost added.
Take the diagonal cell plus the absolute difference between i and j.
Add the row and column indexes, unless they are equal.
Take the minimum of insert, delete, and substitute costs from the left, top, and diagonal cells.
why: 插入、删除、替换/匹配三条路径都可能是最优编辑序列的最后一步，取三者最小值。
why_en: The DP cell takes the minimum over insertion, deletion, and substitution or match, since any of the three could be the last edit.
whenOtherWins: 如果只要求 Hamming distance 且长度相同，逐字符计数即可，不需要完整编辑距离 DP。
tradeoff: 完整三路转移的正确性 vs 简化公式（如只取对角线）的可读性
codeSample:
sub = dp[i - 1][j - 1] + (0 if source[i - 1] == target[j - 1] else 1)
ins = dp[i][j - 1] + 1
dele = dp[i - 1][j] + 1
dp[i][j] = min(ins, dele, sub)

termDefinitions.meaning: DP 表中的一个单元，存的是两个前缀之间的最少编辑次数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: dp[i][j] is a table cell holding the minimum edit distance between two string prefixes.

optionExplanations: 用 max 会把三条候选路径里最大的那个当结果，系统性算出偏大的编辑距离。
坐标差和两个字符是否相同没有关系，这个公式跟内容脱节。
完全跳过了字符比较，只用坐标和，也跟字符串内容无关。
对，这一步要在补一个字符、删一个字符、或者直接对齐这三种可能里选代价最小的，答案就是这三者的最小值。
optionExplanations_en: Taking the max keeps whichever candidate path costs the most, which systematically overestimates the true edit distance.
The coordinate gap has nothing to do with whether the two characters match, so this formula is disconnected from the actual content.
This skips character comparison entirely and only adds coordinates, again ignoring the string contents.
Right — this step has to pick the cheapest among three possible moves: filling in a character, removing one, or lining them up as-is; the cell holds whichever option costs the least.

scenario: 在 Levenshtein DP 中，source = `cat`，target = `car`，两者只有最后一位字符不同（t 对 r）。
scenario_en: In Levenshtein DP, source = `cat` and target = `car`; only the last character differs, t versus r.
q: 此时编辑距离最可能是多少，对应哪种转移？
q_en: What is the likely edit distance here, and which transition does it use?
options: 只需把最后一位替换成 r，一次编辑即可完成
长度相同，所以编辑距离一定是 0
先删除 t 再插入 r，需要两次编辑
要重排所有字符，编辑距离等于字符串长度
options_en: Substitute the last character to r, one edit is enough.
Same length, so the edit distance must be zero.
Delete t then insert r, which takes two edits.
All characters must be rearranged, so distance equals string length.
why: 只有末位字符不同，一次替换就够；长度相同不代表距离为 0，替换也比先删后插更省。
why_en: Only the last character differs, so a single substitution suffices; equal length does not mean zero distance, and one substitution beats a delete-then-insert pair.
optionExplanations: 对，末位是唯一不同的字符，一次替换就能补齐差异。
长度相同不等于内容相同，末位字符不一样，距离不可能是 0。
先删再插要两步，而一次替换就能达到同样效果，明显更省。
只有末位一个字符不同，用不着把整串重排。
optionExplanations_en: Right — only the trailing letter is wrong, so a single swap-in-place is all it takes to close the gap.
Same length doesn't guarantee same content — the last characters differ, so the distance can't be zero.
Delete-then-insert takes two separate steps, while a single swap-in-place reaches the same result more cheaply.
The mismatch is confined to that one trailing letter, so nothing else in the string needs to be reshuffled.

scenario: spell checker 对长 m 的 query 和长 n 的候选词填完整张 DP 表，现在要读出两者的最终编辑距离。
scenario_en: The spell checker has filled the whole DP table for a query of length m and a candidate of length n, and now needs to read off the final edit distance.
q: 完整编辑距离位于 DP 表的哪个位置？
q_en: Where is the full edit distance located in the DP table?
options: `dp[m][n]`，两个完整字符串前缀之间的距离
`dp[0][0]`，两个空串之间的距离
`dp[1][1]`，只比较首字符
第一行的最大值，不是标准定义
options_en: dp[m][n], the distance between the two full-length prefixes.
dp[0][0], the distance between two empty strings.
dp[1][1], comparing only the first characters.
The maximum value in the first row, which is not the standard definition.
why: m、n 分别是 source、target 的完整长度，右下角单元格就是两个完整字符串间的最小编辑次数。
why_en: m and n are the full lengths of source and target, so the bottom-right cell holds the edit distance between the two complete strings.

termDefinitions.meaning: DP 表中的一个单元，存的是两个前缀之间的最少编辑次数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: dp[i][j] is a table cell holding the minimum edit distance between two string prefixes.

optionExplanations: 对，m 和 n 就是两个字符串各自的总长度，因此右下角单元格代表两串从头比到尾的完整结果。
dp[0][0] 是起点边界，代表两个空串之间的距离，不是最终答案。
dp[1][1] 只比较了两边各一个字符，远没覆盖完整字符串。
DP 表里从来没有取第一行最大值当答案这回事。
optionExplanations_en: Right — m and n are just the character counts of the two strings, so dp[m][n] is the result once you've walked through both from the very first letter to the very last.
dp[0][0] is the starting boundary, comparing two empty strings against each other, not the final answer.
dp[1][1] only compares one character from each side, far short of the full strings.
There is no such rule in DP tables as taking the max of the first row as the answer.

scenario: 字典很小，你希望最直接地得到正确建议列表。
scenario_en: The dictionary is small, and you want the simplest correct suggestion list.
q: 第一版最自然的做法是什么？
q_en: What is the most natural first version?
options: 对每个候选词都算一次完整距离，再过滤排序
只看首字母是否相同，完全忽略其余所有字符和位置信息
随机挑几个高频词直接当作拼写建议返回给用户
用拓扑排序的方式，把整本字典重新排列一遍
options_en: Compute a full edit distance for every word, then filter and sort.
Only check whether the first letters match, ignoring every other character and its position.
Randomly pick a few high-frequency words and return them to the user as suggestions.
Rearrange the entire dictionary using a topological sort.
why: 全扫描完整表达题意：每个候选都算距离，保留阈值内的词，再按排名规则截断。
why_en: The full-scan baseline directly matches the spec: compute distance to every candidate, keep those within the threshold, then rank and truncate.
whenOtherWins: 大字典或交互式延迟要求下，全扫描太慢，需要先用便宜下界过滤候选。
tradeoff: 实现最直接、最容易验证正确性 vs 大字典下每个 query 都要付出全量计算代价
optionExplanations: 对，完整算距离、按阈值过滤、按规则排序，正好照着题意把三件事都做到。
只比首字母会漏掉像 car 打成 kar 这种首字母错但其余接近的词。
随机给高频词完全没有用到 query 和候选之间的相似度。
字典词之间并没有先后依赖关系，拓扑排序解决的是另一类问题。
optionExplanations_en: Right — computing the full distance, filtering by threshold, and sorting by the rule together directly implement the spec.
Matching only the first letter misses typos like car mistyped as kar, where the rest is close but the first letter is wrong.
Returning random high-frequency words never uses the similarity between the query and the candidates at all.
Dictionary words have no dependency order between them — topological sort solves a different kind of problem.

q: 把 full scan 版 suggest 流程排成正确顺序：
q_en: Put the full-scan `suggest` flow in the correct order:
steps: 对每个 candidate 计算 edit_distance(query, candidate)
只保留 dist <= maxDistance 的候选
按 distance 升序、frequency 降序、word 升序排序
返回前 maxSuggestions 个 word
why: 全扫描先为每个候选词付出完整 DP 成本，再用统一的排序规则决定最终展示顺序。
why_en: The full-scan flow pays the full DP cost for every dictionary word first, then applies the same ranking rule to decide the final order.
tradeoff: 实现顺序的直观性 vs 大字典下的总运行时间
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Dict[Dictionary] --> DP[Compute distance]
  DP --> Filter[Keep within max]
  Filter --> Sort[Sort by distance frequency word]
  Sort --> Top[Return top suggestions]

scenario: `scored` 中每项是 `(candidate, dist, freq)`，需要按题目排序。
scenario_en: Each item in `scored` is `(candidate, dist, freq)`, and you need to sort by the problem rule.
q: 哪段排序 key 正确？
q_en: Which sorting key is correct?
options: scored.sort(key=lambda r: (-r[1], r[2]))
scored.sort(key=lambda r: r[0])
scored.sort(key=lambda r: (r[1], -r[2], r[0]))
scored.sort(key=lambda r: (-r[2], r[1]))
options_en: Sort by distance descending, then frequency ascending.
Sort only by the candidate word itself, ignoring distance and frequency.
Sort by distance ascending, then frequency descending, then word ascending.
Sort by frequency descending first, then distance ascending.
why: 距离优先升序，频率次之降序，最后用单词本身做稳定 tie-break。
why_en: Sort by distance ascending first, frequency descending second, and the word itself as a stable final tie-break.
whenOtherWins: 如果产品规则要求频率优先于距离，排序 key 才会换成频率在前；本文明确距离优先。
tradeoff: 距离优先（更像目标词优先）vs 频率优先（更常见词优先）
codeSample:
scored.sort(key=lambda r: (r[1], -r[2], r[0]))
return [r[0] for r in scored[:max_suggestions]]

termDefinitions.meaning: 多个候选得分完全相同时，用来决定最终顺序的额外规则。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A tie-break is an extra rule that orders candidates whose primary scores are exactly equal.

optionExplanations: 把距离和频率的方向都反了，会让离目标词最远的候选排到最前面。
完全没用到距离和频率，编辑距离更小的候选反而可能被排到后面。
对，距离升序为主键、频率降序为次键，最后用单词本身兜底，严格对应题目规则。
让频率盖过距离，一个高频但拼写更远的词会排到一个低频却更接近 query 的词前面，违反本文的距离优先规则。
optionExplanations_en: This flips both directions, putting the candidate farthest from the target word at the very top.
This ignores distance and frequency entirely, so a much closer candidate can end up ranked lower.
Right — distance ascending leads, frequency descending breaks the next tie, and the raw word text settles anything still knotted, exactly matching the rule.
Letting frequency outrank distance ranks a common but farther-off word above a closer but rarer match, breaking the article's distance-first rule.

scenario: 字典有 D 个词，平均候选长度 L，query 长度 Q；full scan 版对每个候选都跑一次完整 Levenshtein DP。
scenario_en: The dictionary has D words, average candidate length is L, query length is Q, and full scan runs a full Levenshtein DP for every candidate.
q: 总时间复杂度最接近哪一个？
q_en: Which total time complexity is closest?
options: O(D + Q + L)
O(log D)
O(D · Q · L)
options_en: O of D plus Q plus L.
O of log D.
O of D times Q times L.
O of two to the power of Q.
why: D 个候选各自跑一次 Q×L 的 DP 表，总成本按乘积增长，不是简单相加。
why_en: Each of the D candidates runs its own Q-by-L DP table, so total cost grows as a product, not a sum.

termDefinitions.meaning: 描述算法运行时间随输入规模增长趋势的记号。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Big-O notation describes the upper-bound growth rate of an algorithm as input size increases.

termDefinitions.meaning: Burkhard-Keller tree（BK-tree）：按编辑距离组织词典的树，靠三角不等式剪掉整棵子树。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A BK-tree, or Burkhard-Keller tree, indexes a dictionary by edit distance so the triangle inequality can prune whole subtrees.

optionExplanations: 把三者相加意味着每个候选只做常数工作，但这里每个候选都要填满一张 Q×L 的表。
对数级需要一个能按编辑距离剪枝的索引（如 BK-tree）；full scan 没有任何索引。
对，总成本 = 候选数 × 单张表格面积，三个因子相乘。
指数级出现在枚举所有编辑序列的暴力递归里；DP 用备忘表把它压回多项式。
optionExplanations_en: Adding the three terms assumes constant work per candidate, but here every candidate needs a full Q-by-L table filled in.
Logarithmic time needs an index that prunes by edit distance, like a BK-tree, and full scan has no index at all.
Right — total cost is candidate count times the area of one table, so the three factors multiply.
Exponential time shows up in the brute-force recursion that enumerates every edit sequence; DP memoizes it back down to polynomial.

scenario: 10 万词字典、maxDistance=2，full scan 版对每一个候选词都新建并填满一张 Q×L 的 DP 表。
scenario_en: With a 100k-word dictionary and maxDistance of 2, the full-scan version allocates and fills a Q-by-L DP table for every single candidate.
q: full scan 为什么在大字典上慢？
q_en: Why is full scan slow on a large dictionary?
options: 排序 key 无法正确比较字符串大小
每个候选都新建 DP 表，多数结果被丢弃
maxDistance 默认设置得太小了
候选频率越高，DP 计算越慢
options_en: The sort key cannot correctly compare strings.
Every candidate allocates a fresh DP table, and most results get discarded.
The default maxDistance is set too small.
Higher-frequency candidates make the DP slower.
why: 大部分候选词最终会被距离阈值过滤掉，但 full scan 仍先为它们付出完整 DP 的分配和填表成本。
why_en: Most candidates end up filtered out by the distance threshold, but full scan still pays the full allocation and DP cost for every one of them first.
optionExplanations: 排序只对少量幸存候选跑一次，从来不是这里的性能瓶颈。
对，真正拖慢速度的是大量候选压根用不上却依然被分配、填表，等跑完才被距离阈值挡在门外。
阈值大小只影响过滤松紧，不影响要不要先建表。
DP 只依赖字符串长度，跟这个词出现的频率没有关系。
optionExplanations_en: Sorting only runs once over the few surviving candidates — it was never the bottleneck here.
Right — most candidates get a DP table allocated and filled for them even though they were never going to qualify, and only get turned away once that math is already done.
The threshold value only changes how strict the filter is, not whether a table gets built in the first place.
DP cost depends only on string length, not on how frequently that word appears.

scenario: 字典约 50,000 词。第一版对每个 query 都把它和字典里每个词跑一遍 Levenshtein DP，再按距离和词频排序。
scenario_en: The dictionary has about 50,000 words. The first version runs Levenshtein DP from each query to every dictionary word, then sorts by distance and frequency.
q: 与其记住约 280ms 这个 benchmark，更重要的系统含义是什么？
q_en: Rather than memorizing the roughly 280 ms benchmark, what system meaning matters more?
options: 280ms 已经足够快，不需要再优化
词典越大，每个词的 DP 会自动变便宜
瓶颈是 query 数乘字典大小乘 DP 成本，该做候选剪枝
Levenshtein DP 不适合用在拼写检查上
options_en: 280ms is already fast enough, so no further optimization is needed.
A larger dictionary automatically makes each word's DP cheaper.
The bottleneck is queries times dictionary size times DP cost, so prune candidates first.
Levenshtein DP is simply the wrong algorithm for spell checking.
why: 280ms 对交互式输入来说太慢；真正瓶颈是 query 数乘字典大小乘 DP 成本，下一步该做候选剪枝而非死记这个数字。
why_en: 280ms is too slow for interactive typing; the real bottleneck is queries times dictionary size times DP cost, so the fix is candidate pruning, not memorizing the figure.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把一个字符串变成另一个所需的最少插入、删除、替换次数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Levenshtein distance is the minimum number of insertions, deletions, and substitutions needed to turn one string into another.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在昂贵计算前，先用便宜规则排除明显不可能的候选。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Candidate pruning removes clearly impossible candidates with a cheap check before running expensive computation.

optionExplanations: 280ms 对打字过程中的实时提示来说其实太慢，不该止步于此。
字典变大只会让候选数变多，单次 DP 成本不会因此自动变便宜。
对，把总耗时拆开看就是请求量乘字典规模乘每次 DP 的开销，真正该动手的地方是先把候选砍少，而不是把这个具体毫秒数背下来。
DP 本身没有问题，问题出在要不要为每个候选都跑一次，算法选型不用换。
optionExplanations_en: 280ms actually drags behind what real-time typing feedback needs, so this isn't a good place to stop.
A bigger dictionary only adds more candidates — a single DP call doesn't get cheaper because of that.

Right — break the total time down and it's requests multiplied by dictionary size multiplied by per-call DP cost; the real fix is cutting candidates down first, not memorizing this one millisecond figure.
The DP itself is fine; the real issue is running it on every candidate, not the choice of algorithm.

scenario: maxDistance 很小，字典很大，你想在运行昂贵 DP 前用一个一定安全的便宜下界排除多数 candidate。
scenario_en: maxDistance is small, the dictionary is large, and you want a cheap safe lower bound to reject most candidates before expensive DP.
q: 应该先做什么检查？
q_en: What check should run first?
options: candidate 出现的频率低于 query 本身的长度，就直接跳过不算
candidate 的首字母只要跟 query 不一样，就一定要跳过
candidate 只要没排进前五名，就直接跳过不再考虑
candidate 与 query 的长度差超过 maxDistance 就跳过
options_en: Skip whenever the candidate's frequency happens to be lower than the query's own length.
Skip whenever the candidate's first letter is different from the query's first letter.
Skip whenever the candidate isn't ranked in the top five, no further checks needed.
Skip when the candidate's length differs from the query's by more than maxDistance.
why: 每次编辑最多改变长度 1，长度差已经超过阈值时，真实 edit distance 必定也超过阈值。
why_en: Each edit changes length by at most one, so once the length gap exceeds the threshold, the true edit distance must exceed it too.
whenOtherWins: 如果允许任意长度替换或整段粘贴这类非 Levenshtein 操作，这个下界就需要重新证明。
tradeoff: 一行长度检查的安全剪枝 vs 完整 DP 才能给出的精确距离

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个保证不会高估真实代价的便宜估计，可用来安全拒绝候选。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A lower bound is a cheap estimate guaranteed never to exceed the true cost, safe to use for rejecting candidates.

diagram:
flowchart LR
  Query[Query length] --> Diff[Length difference]
  Cand[Candidate length] --> Diff
  Diff --> Gate{Diff greater than max?}
  Gate -->|yes| Skip[Skip DP]
  Gate -->|no| DP[Run edit distance]
optionExplanations: 频率和编辑距离没有数学关系，用它做筛选会误杀真正合格的候选。
首字母打错的 typo，比如 car 打成 kar，会被这条规则误杀。
此刻排序还没发生，根本没有名次可以拿来筛选。
对，插入删除每挪一次，字符串长度也就跟着变一格；两边长度差一旦超过阈值，就代表就算全用插入删除去补，也补不平了。
optionExplanations_en: Frequency has no mathematical relationship to how far apart two spellings are, so filtering on it would wrongly reject valid candidates.
A typo with a wrong first letter, like car typed as kar, would be wrongly rejected by this rule.
Sorting hasn't happened yet at this point, so there is no rank to filter on.
Right — every insertion or deletion nudges the string length by exactly one slot; push that gap past the allowed threshold and no combination of inserts and deletes can close it anymore.

q: 补全长度下界：
q_en: Complete the length lower bound:
text: 把长度 m 的字符串变成长度 n，至少需要 {{|m-n|}} 次会改变长度的编辑；因此 edit distance >= {{|m-n|}}。
why: 替换不改变长度，插入/删除每次只改变 1，所以长度差是编辑距离绕不过去的下界。
why_en: Substitution keeps length unchanged while insertion and deletion each change it by one, so the length gap is an unavoidable lower bound on edit distance.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个保证不会高估真实代价的便宜估计，可用来安全拒绝候选。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A lower bound is a cheap estimate guaranteed never to exceed the true cost, safe to use for rejecting candidates.

scenario: 你正在优化 suggest 循环，希望大部分明显长度不可能的 candidate 不进入 DP。
scenario_en: You are optimizing the `suggest` loop and want most obviously impossible-length candidates to avoid DP.
q: 哪段代码应该放在 `edit_distance` 调用之前？
q_en: Which code should run before calling `edit_distance`?
options: if abs(len(candidate) - word_len) > max_distance: continue
if candidate == word: continue
if edit_distance(word, candidate) > max_distance: continue
if freq < 0: continue
options_en: Skip when the length gap exceeds max_distance, before computing edit distance.
Skip when the candidate exactly equals the query.
Skip when the computed edit distance exceeds max_distance.
Skip when frequency is negative.
why: 长度检查必须放在 DP 调用之前，才能让明显不可能的候选完全避开昂贵计算。
why_en: The length guard must run before the DP call so obviously impossible candidates skip the expensive computation entirely.
whenOtherWins: 小字典上这个 guard 可能收益不明显，但大字典和短 query 上非常有效。
tradeoff: 事前用长度差拦截 vs 事后用完整 DP 结果再过滤
optionExplanations: 对，把这行便宜判断挪到 DP 前面，绝大多数候选根本不会碰到那张表，昂贵计算只留给真正可能达标的少数词。
覆盖面太窄，绝大多数候选都不是完全相同，这条判断救不了性能。
判断放在了 DP 算完之后，成本已经付出，起不到事前优化的效果。
真实词频不会是负数，这个条件在实际数据里永远不会触发。
optionExplanations_en: Right — move this cheap check ahead of the DP call, and most candidates never even touch the table; the costly work only happens for the handful that could actually still qualify.
This covers too little ground — almost no candidate is an exact match, so it does nothing for performance.
This check runs after the DP already finished, so the cost is already paid and nothing is saved.
Real word frequencies are never negative, so this condition would never actually trigger.

scenario: query `helo` 长度为 4，maxDistance = 2。
scenario_en: The query `helo` has length 4, and maxDistance = 2.
q: 候选词的哪个长度区间会真正进入 DP 计算？
q_en: Which candidate length range actually enters DP?
options: 只允许 4
1 到 10 全部允许
7 以上全部允许
options_en: Only length 4.
Lengths 2 through 6.
All lengths from 1 to 10.
Any length 7 or above.
why: 长度差不能超过 2，所以候选长度范围是 [4-2, 4+2]，也就是 2 到 6。
why_en: The length gap cannot exceed 2, so candidate lengths must fall between 4 minus 2 and 4 plus 2, i.e. 2 through 6.

scenario: 字典有 50,088 个词；query 是 `helo`（长度 4），maxDistance = 2。长度过滤后只剩约 96 个候选真正进入 DP，其余约 5 万个被直接跳过。
scenario_en: The dictionary has 50,088 words; query is `helo` with length 4, and maxDistance = 2. After length filtering, only about 96 candidates enter DP and about 50,000 are skipped.
q: 这个数量对比最支持哪条设计判断？
q_en: Which design judgment does this count comparison best support?
options: 候选数量增多就必须换用更复杂的数据结构
便宜的下界检查能在昂贵计算前排除绝大多数候选
maxDistance 应该直接调成 0 来省时间
过滤只在候选数很少的小字典上才有意义
options_en: More candidates always means you must switch to a more complex data structure.
A cheap lower-bound check can reject the vast majority of candidates before expensive work.
maxDistance should just be set to zero to save time.
Filtering only matters when the dictionary is already small.
why: 96 对 50,088 说明一次长度检查就能挡掉 99% 以上候选，昂贵 DP 只需对少数幸存者跑。
why_en: 96 out of 50,088 shows that a one-line length check alone rejects over 99 percent of candidates, leaving expensive DP for only the few survivors.
optionExplanations: 这组数字恰恰说明不用先换复杂结构，一行长度检查已经挡掉了绝大多数候选。
对，两个数字摆在一起说明：绝大多数候选根本没资格进入昂贵计算，便宜的一步过滤就能把 99% 以上挡在门外。
把阈值直接调到 0 会丢掉真正需要的拼写建议，跟这组数字要说明的道理无关。
这组数字用的正是 50,088 词的大字典，说明过滤在大字典上反而收益最大。
optionExplanations_en: This count actually shows the opposite — a single cheap length check already blocked most candidates well before any fancier structure was needed.
Right — put the two numbers side by side and it says most candidates never deserved the expensive step at all; a single cheap filter turns away well over 99 out of every 100.
Setting the threshold straight to zero would drop real suggestions users need — that's unrelated to what this count demonstrates.
This count comes from the large 50,088-word dictionary, showing the filter actually pays off most on large dictionaries.

scenario: 把 full scan 换成先按长度差跳过候选的版本，产品要求建议列表和旧版逐条一致。
scenario_en: You swap full scan for a version that skips candidates by length difference, and the product requires the suggestion list to match the old one item for item.
q: 长度过滤版与 full scan 哪些部分保持相同？（多选）
q_en: Which parts stay the same between length filtering and full scan? (multi-select)
options: 对进入 band 的候选仍使用同一个 edit_distance DP
仍按 distance、frequency、word 排序
不再需要 maxDistance
仍只返回 maxSuggestions 个
options_en: Candidates inside the band still run through the same edit_distance DP.
Results are still ranked by distance, frequency, and word.
maxDistance is no longer needed.
Only maxSuggestions results are still returned.
why: 长度过滤只是前置安全拒绝，核心距离计算、排序和截断语义都保持不变。
why_en: The length filter is only a cheap pre-check; the core distance computation, ranking, and truncation logic stay exactly the same.
optionExplanations: 对，长度过滤只是前置检查，进入 band 的候选还是要跑完整同一个 DP。
排序规则完全没动，距离、频率、单词三个键的优先级和 baseline 一致。
长度差只是安全下界，不是精确值，仍要靠 DP 结果和 maxDistance 比较才能确定是否合格。
接口截断行为没有变化，调用方看到的返回条数上限还是 maxSuggestions。
optionExplanations_en: Right — the length-based filter is only a pre-check; candidates that land inside the band still run through the exact same DP afterward.
The ranking rule never changed — distance, frequency, and word keep the same priority as the baseline.
The length gap is only a safe lower bound, not the exact value, so DP results still need to be compared against maxDistance.
The truncation behavior is unchanged — callers still see at most maxSuggestions results.

scenario: 10 万词字典、maxDistance=2，先用长度差跳过候选，再对剩下的 D′ 个词跑完整 DP。
scenario_en: On a 100k-word dictionary with maxDistance 2, you skip candidates by length difference first and only run the full DP on the remaining D-prime words.
q: 长度过滤如何改变实际工作量？
q_en: How does length filtering change the actual work?
options: 把最坏情况复杂度直接降到 O(1) 常数级别
彻底删除了单次 DP 本身的 Q·L 计算成本
最坏仍是 O(D·Q·L)，但只对少数候选真正跑 DP
让排序取代 DP，成为流程里唯一的主要成本
options_en: It drops the worst-case complexity straight down to constant-time O(1).
It entirely removes the per-call Q-times-L cost of the DP computation itself.
Worst case is still O(D times Q times L), but in practice DP only runs for the few surviving candidates.
It makes sorting take over from DP as the pipeline's only real cost.
why: 最坏情况下所有词都可能落在 band 内，公式不变；但真实大字典里 D' 远小于 D，常数因子大幅下降。
why_en: The worst-case formula is unchanged because a pathological dictionary could keep every word in the band, but in practice D-prime is far smaller than D.
tradeoff: 理论最坏复杂度不变 vs 实际运行时常数因子大幅下降

termDefinitions.meaning: 描述算法运行时间随输入规模增长趋势的记号。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Big-O notation describes the upper-bound growth rate of an algorithm as input size increases.

optionExplanations: 病态字典下所有词长度都相同时，长度过滤完全起不到作用，复杂度并没有降到常数级。
band 内候选仍要跑完整 Q×L 的 DP 表，单次 DP 本身的成本没有被删掉。
对，最坏情况的公式没有变，但大字典里真正跑进 DP 的候选数 D' 远小于全部候选数 D，实际跑起来快了一大截。
排序只对少量幸存候选进行，量级远小于 DP，从来不是主要开销。
optionExplanations_en: In a worst-case dictionary where every word shares one length, the filter does nothing at all, so the complexity never actually falls to constant time.
Candidates inside the band still run the full Q-by-L DP table — the per-call DP cost itself is never removed.
Right — the theoretical ceiling stays the same, but in a real large dictionary the number of candidates that actually reach DP, D', ends up much smaller than the full D, so it runs noticeably faster.
Sorting only touches the few survivors and is far smaller in magnitude than DP — it was never the main cost.

scenario: 针对 50,088 词大字典跑 10 个 query 的 batch：full scan 总耗时约 2.71 秒，length filter 版总耗时约 22 毫秒。
scenario_en: On a 50,088-word dictionary and a batch of 10 queries, full scan takes about 2.71 seconds total, while the length-filter version takes about 22 milliseconds.
q: 这组 benchmark 最支持哪条设计判断？
q_en: Which design judgment does this benchmark best support?
options: 只要字典体量变大，就必须换一门更快的编程语言重写整个实现
廉价的长度下界挡掉了几乎所有候选，把大字典也拉回交互级延迟
这说明可以彻底跳过 DP 计算，只靠长度差就能当最终答案

DP 在任意规模字典上都能正常运行，跟字典大小无关。

maxSuggestions 控制 DP 表大小
options_en: maxDistance defaults to about 2.
maxSuggestions defaults to about 5.
maxDistance = 2 is a practical ceiling for single-word typos.
maxSuggestions controls the size of the DP table.

optionExplanations: 对，这是 maxDistance 的默认取值，决定候选是否算足够接近。

q: 为什么同距离时要把更高频词排在前面？
q_en: Why rank the higher-frequency word first when distance ties?
options: 用户更可能想打常见词，如 `teh` 更像 `the`
高频词的 edit distance 自动更小
频率会让 DP 表变得更小
低频词根本不会出现在字典中
options_en: Users more likely meant a common word, so teh is more likely the.
A high-frequency word automatically has a smaller edit distance.
Frequency makes the DP table itself smaller.
Low-frequency words never appear in the dictionary at all.
why: 距离相同只说明拼写接近程度一样，频率补充了用户更可能想打哪个词的概率信号。
why_en: Equal distance only means equal spelling closeness; frequency adds the missing signal for which word the user more likely intended.
optionExplanations: 对，同距离下，猜用户打错了一个常见词，比猜他打错了一个生僻词更合理。
编辑距离只看字符差异，跟这个词出现的频率完全无关。
DP 表大小只由字符串长度决定，跟频率没有关系。
字典本身就是词到频率的映射，低频词照样在字典里，只是排序靠后。
optionExplanations_en: Right — at equal distance, betting the user meant to type a common word is a better guess than betting on a rare one.
Edit distance is purely a function of character differences and has nothing to do with how often a word shows up.
DP table size is determined only by string length, not by frequency.
The dictionary is itself a word-to-frequency map — low-frequency words are still in it, just ranked lower.

scenario: 你有一个昂贵的精确函数和一个便宜的安全下界；当下界已经超过阈值时，精确函数不可能通过。
scenario_en: You have an expensive exact function and a cheap safe lower bound; when the bound already exceeds the threshold, the exact function cannot pass.
q: 应该采用什么通用优化模式？
q_en: Which general optimization pattern should you use?
options: 总是先运行那个昂贵的函数
把阈值判断整个删除掉
先用便宜下界拒绝，再跑精确计算
随机跳过一半候选不做判断
options_en: Always run the expensive function first, no matter what.
Remove the threshold check entirely.
Reject with the cheap bound first, then run the exact computation.
Randomly skip half the candidates without checking anything.
why: 长度差就是编辑距离的安全下界；先做便宜拒绝能避免大量无用的 DP 计算。
why_en: The length gap is a provably safe lower bound on edit distance, so rejecting on it first avoids running DP on candidates that cannot pass anyway.
whenOtherWins: 如果下界计算本身很贵或过滤率很低，就要重新评估是否值得。
tradeoff: 先便宜拒绝再精确计算 vs 直接对所有候选跑精确计算

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个保证不会高估真实代价的便宜估计，可用来安全拒绝候选。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A lower bound is a cheap estimate guaranteed never to exceed the true cost, safe to use for rejecting candidates.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在昂贵计算前，先用便宜规则排除明显不可能的候选。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Candidate pruning removes clearly impossible candidates with a cheap check before running expensive computation.

optionExplanations: 先跑贵的函数就失去了提前拒绝能省下的全部计算量，顺序恰恰是关键。
没有阈值就没法判断候选是否合格，这个判断本身是必须的。
对，先用便宜下界安全拒绝，只对幸存者跑精确计算，这正是长度过滤用的模式。
随机丢弃没有安全保证，可能误删本来合格的候选。
optionExplanations_en: Running the expensive function first loses all the savings that rejecting early could have captured — order is exactly the point.
Without a threshold there's no way to decide whether a candidate qualifies — the check itself is necessary.
Right — reject cheaply with the bound first and run the exact computation only on survivors, exactly the pattern the length filter uses.
Randomly dropping candidates has no safety guarantee and can wrongly discard ones that would otherwise have qualified.

scenario: spell checker 在跑昂贵的 DP 之前，先用长度差这个便宜下界安全地拒掉大多数候选。
scenario_en: Before paying for the expensive DP, the spell checker uses the cheap length-difference lower bound to safely reject most candidates.
q: 这种"先用便宜下界拒绝、再做昂贵精确判断"的模式对应哪些通用优化？（多选）

options: metric space 的 triangle inequality pruning
set lookup 前的 bloom filter prefilter
精确几何相交前的 bounding-box check
无条件计算所有昂贵函数
options_en: Triangle-inequality pruning in a metric space.
A Bloom-filter prefilter before a set lookup.
A bounding-box check before exact geometric intersection.
Unconditionally computing every expensive function.
why: 它们都先做便宜且安全的拒绝，再对少数剩余候选付昂贵精确计算，和长度过滤同一个模式。
why_en: All three examples reject candidates cheaply and safely before spending on exact computation for the few survivors, the same pattern as the length filter.

termDefinitions.meaning: 两点间的直接距离不会超过绕经第三点的路径和，可用来安全排除不可能的候选。

对，bounding-box 检查用便宜的矩形先挡掉明显不可能相交的图形。
这正是 full scan 想要避免的做法，是被优化掉的反例，不是类比对象。

Right — a Bloom filter is the same shape of cheap prefilter, with false positives but no false negatives.
Right — a bounding-box check uses a cheap rectangle to rule out shapes that obviously cannot intersect.
This is exactly the approach the optimization is trying to avoid — it's the counter-example, not an analogy.

BK-tree
拓扑排序队列

Right — once the threshold is tight, the answer can only live in a narrow strip hugging the diagonal; banded DP simply never fills the rest, and can bail out of a row early once it's clearly hopeless.

scenario: spell checker 在 10 万词字典上仍然慢，要判断三种常见优化各自打在流程的哪一层。

options: 三者都只改变排序
长度过滤减候选数，BK-tree 剪子树，banded DP 降单次成本
三者都删除 maxDistance
长度过滤提高频率，BK-tree 修改词典，banded DP 修改 query
options_en: All three only change the sort order.
Length filter cuts candidates, BK-tree prunes subtrees, banded DP cuts per-call cost.

why: 三者处理不同瓶颈：谁能进入 DP、如何索引候选、每次 DP 要填多少格子。
why_en: The three optimizations target different bottlenecks: which candidates enter DP, how candidates are indexed, and how many cells each DP call fills.
tradeoff: 三层优化各自的实现复杂度 vs 各自能省下的计算量
optionExplanations: 三者其实都发生在排序之前，排序规则从头到尾没被它们碰过。
对，三层各管一段：一层决定谁有资格进 DP，一层决定怎么快速定位候选，最后一层决定每次 DP 该填多少格子。
maxDistance 仍然是判断候选是否合格的阈值，三者都没有删掉它。
三者都不会篡改字典内容、query 本身或词的频率。
optionExplanations_en: All three actually happen before sorting — the ranking rule itself is never touched by any of them.
Right — each layer owns a different piece: one decides who's even eligible for DP, one decides how fast candidates get located, and the last decides how much work a single DP call has to do.
maxDistance is still the threshold that decides whether a candidate qualifies — none of the three removes it.
None of the three touches the dictionary contents, the query itself, or word frequencies.

scenario: spell checker 的建议列表要在 CI 里做断言，同 distance 同 frequency 的候选顺序必须可复现。

让 maxSuggestions 变大
避免顺序依赖字典遍历，保持结果稳定
会把低频词直接从字典中删除

It makes maxSuggestions larger.
It avoids depending on dictionary iteration order, keeping results stable.
It deletes low-frequency words from the dictionary entirely.
why: 没有最终 tie-break 时，同分词的顺序会跟着字典内部遍历顺序漂移，测试和产品体验都不稳定。
why_en: Without a final tie-break, equally-scored words could reorder with the dictionary's internal iteration order, making both tests and the product feel unstable.

termDefinitions.meaning: 多个候选得分完全相同时，用来决定最终顺序的额外规则。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A tie-break is an extra rule that orders candidates whose primary scores are exactly equal.

optionExplanations: tie-break 只决定同分候选谁排前面，不会改变任何一个已经算好的距离值。

optionExplanations_en: The tie-break only decides which of two tied-score candidates comes first — it never changes an already-computed distance.

Right — without this fallback, two tied candidates fall back on whatever order they happen to sit in internally, so a different run can flip the order and the list the user sees can shift underneath them.
The tie-break only reorders candidates — it never drops any of them, so low-frequency words stay in the results.
